notes: Priority ruling for this period: WO-0007, giving RunState a seed and a tick counter, takes priority 1 and the next unit of engineering and quality capacity. It is the right piece of work precisely because it needs no design input. Run identity is not a game-design question about what the game should be; it is determinism plumbing that ADR-0001 already committed the studio to when it required all randomness to come from a seeded IRng and all time to arrive as a dt parameter. RunState today carries score, kills, elapsed seconds and an is-over flag, and neither a seed nor a tick count, so a run cannot be named or replayed: no agent can write 'run seed 8817441 at tick 4200' in a defect report because neither number exists. That makes every seeded-replay claim downstream unfalsifiable, weakens the regression ratchet on which the whole verification model rests, and means the headless balance simulation waiting behind WO-0004 would be built on runs nobody can reproduce. Engineering can implement it entirely inside Assets/Core with no UnityEngine reference, and quality can test it in milliseconds with no Unity licence, so both active divisions can finish it while product-design stays dormant. It is L3 and reversible, and its cost is small against the value of unblocking reproducibility before more code depends on the unreproducible shape. Boundaries observed: I have not written the WO-0007 work order or its acceptance criteria; that is work-order-author's job, deliberately separated so no one defines the success criteria of work they will also judge. I have marked nothing complete; completion comes only from a gate verdict. The four founder items above are already carried in the humanQueue of project-state, so needsFounderAttention is empty rather than inflated with escalation records that do not exist. WO-0002 remains the single highest-value founder action: it alone releases eleven agents and gate G1.
